name: Packages
insp: glass and gradient software launch and pricing pages
desc: Built on the firm's own promise of fixed fees. A live gradient mesh in the brand blues and greens flows behind glass cards and bends toward your cursor; the three real packages fly in from depth, tilt as you hover and flip over to compare every inclusion.
fx: Hand-written gradient mesh hero that bends toward your cursor
Headline splits in word by word
Package cards fly in from depth and tilt with a light sheen on hover
Compare everything flips the cards to the full lists, ticks drawing in one by one
The four service areas pin and expand one at a time
4K brand render drifts slowly behind the packages
